mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger immediate risk-off behavior, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.3pp in a month, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate collapsing household wealth and reduced consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with rising industrial production (INDPRO > 102.5) and falling unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), slowing earnings growth triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals expanding household wealth and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that forces the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% y/y, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market contraction not captured by unemployment alone, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both PAYEMS and UNRATE decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle with rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.
